author: NASASpaceflight
description:
Starship Flight 12 delivered the long-awaited debut of Starship Version 3, and this week’s Starship Update breaks down every key moment in detail: Booster 19 lighting all 33 Raptor 3 engines at liftoff, the aggressive 270-degree roll program from Pad 2, record 5,700 km/h hot staging speed, the boostback burn abort, Ship 39’s early RVac shutdown and extended reentry with flawless crossrange maneuvering, successful Starlink simulator deployment, and a clean heatshield splashdown.

We also cover the crewed Mars flyby announcement with Chun Wang, Marmac 31’s arrival at Starbase, new Pad 2 performance, Ship 40 and Booster 20 production updates, McGregor Raptor 3 testing, and major Space Coast progress at LC-39A and SLC-37. Full telemetry analysis, flight footage, and what’s next for Flight 13 - watch now for the deepest Starship recap anywhere.
